svg.title: Concrete pulverizer attachment — Steypumyljari fyrir gröfu
svg.desc: A heavy crushing attachment has a broad fixed jaw and an opposing open lower jaw with pronounced tooth notches.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-concrete-pulverizer","label_en":"Concrete pulverizer attachment","label_is":"Steypumyljari fyrir gröfu","section":"01","category_en":"Earthmoving and demolition machinery","category_is":"Jarðvinnslu- og niðurrifsvélar","batch":1,"tags":["demolition","attachment"],"description":"A heavy crushing attachment has a broad fixed jaw and an opposing open lower jaw with pronounced tooth notches.","design_note":"Wide stepped crushing teeth and deep jaw opening are distinct from thin shear blades.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
